mapper.sql: id, question_hash, question, scope_id, miss_count, first_seen_at_ms, last_seen_at_ms
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_knowledge_gap (question_hash, question, scope_id, miss_count, first_seen_at_ms, last_seen_at_ms) VALUES (#{questionHash}, #{question}, #{scopeId}, 1, #{firstSeenAtMs}, #{lastSeenAtMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE miss_count = miss_count + 1, last_seen_at_ms = VALUES(last_seen_at_ms)
